master.prompt:
Create a single complete loaded game vehicle Long Hauler, long-hauler-6. Brief: 

- Vehicle: cobalt blue highway tractor with its semi-trailer
- Load (drawn as part of the vehicle): a flatbed semi-trailer with three steel coils on chocks
- Equipment: chrome bull bar and air horns
- Finish: polished paint with road dust
- Tires: 1.04 m off-road mud-terrain tires wrapped in heavy steel diamond-pattern chains

. Tractor has exactly 2 axles; integrated semi-trailer has exactly TWO axles, making exactly 4 near-side road wheels in the whole assembled rig. Tractor and trailer road wheels must be identical diameter, all fully visible. Vehicle empty mass 9.1 tonnes; whole vehicle length about 7.3 metres. Its load is integrated securely using straps, chains, cradles or side rails. Draw the full coupled tractor AND trailer as ONE image when present, not separate parts. Keep all near-side tires unobstructed by steps. For banners or flags use blank bold colours, no lettering. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Facing RIGHT, cab front face invisible. Exactly circular near tires, centred rims, level hub centres and tire bottoms. Horizontal chassis and deck, no yaw, no tilt. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration in approved Swamp Scout style: dark readable contours, weathered materials, fine mechanical detail, rich natural texture. Soft even daylight. True transparent background, no ground, cast shadow, glow, lettering, logos or watermark. Entire object has generous clear margins on all four sides, occupies only central 85% of canvas width and 80% of height. Wide PNG at least 1500 pixels across.

body.prompt: Edit target long-hauler-6 supplied master. Remove ONLY all 4 ground-contact road tires and rims from the truck AND trailer. Retain spare tires and any wheels on cars carried as cargo. Fill wheel wells with opaque painted dark liners, chassis, axle and suspension from fender lips to ORIGINAL hub line, including gaps between tandem arches. No transparent holes above hubs. Below hubs and under chassis stays transparent. Preserve exact input canvas dimensions and all non-wheel pixels: body, cargo, straps, cab, equipment, position, scale and camera. No redesign, no shift, no rescale. This is a registered body layer for animation. True transparent background, no glow or shadow. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires.
body.role: Generated wheel-well interior donor; composite preserves original non-wheel pixels.

wheel.prompt: Reference role: near-side road wheel on supplied long-hauler-6 truck. Generate just ONE matching tire and rim, same tread, chains or spikes as master, same rim holes, hub bolts, weathering and painted detail. Perfectly circular tire, centred hub, face-on on a SQUARE 1536x1536 true transparent PNG with equal clear margins. Soft even light for spinning. No vehicle, axle, load, ground, shadow, halo, lettering or logo. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires.
